scripts.runtime:package: uv run --project runtime --extra ai --extra desktop python scripts/package-runtime.py
scripts.test:all: npm run test:ui && npm run test:browser && npm run test:sites
scripts.test:coverage:python: mkdir -p coverage && uv run --project runtime --extra test coverage run --data-file=coverage/.coverage --source=runtime/tribe_runtime -m pytest runtime/tests && uv run --project runtime --extra test coverage xml --data-file=coverage/.coverage --include='runtime/tribe_runtime/*' -o coverage/python.xml
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:javascript && npm run test:coverage:python
scripts.test:ui: node --test tests/activity.test.mjs tests/agent-role-templates.test.mjs tests/channel-scroll.test.mjs tests/plan.test.mjs tests/runtime-events.test.mjs tests/canvas-diff.test.mjs tests/canvas-export.test.mjs tests/canvas-selection.test.mjs tests/artifact-preview.test.mjs tests/artifact-anchor.test.mjs tests/tabular-preview.test.mjs tests/computer-capture.test.mjs tests/interactive-artifact.test.mjs tests/settings-view.test.mjs tests/remote-service-form.test.mjs tests/schedules.test.mjs tests/schedule-view.test.mjs tests/project-knowledge-view.test.mjs tests/slash-commands.test.mjs tests/workflow-designer.test.mjs tests/chart-preview.test.mjs tests/notebook-preview.test.mjs tests/design-systems.test.mjs tests/general-chat-view.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:electron:build: npm run build && npm run runtime:package && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.desktop:electron:mac: npm run build && npm run runtime:package && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:electron:windows: npm run build && npm run runtime:package && electron-builder --win --publish never
